outcome: History of past cesareans, uterine surgery, and curettage
Quantities of transfused erythrocyte suspensions (ES) and fresh frozen plasma (FFP)
cohort: 37 patients diagnosed with placenta percreta who underwent peripartum hysterectomy
finding: All patients with placenta percreta who underwent peripartum hysterectomy had a history of cesarean section and placenta previa totalis, highlighting these factors as significant risk factors.
gest_age: Average gestational age at birth was 35 weeks.
birth_weight: Normal birth weight in relation to gestational age.
